architecture_assessment.conversational_recovery: The contract loses refine_previous in six cases and reference handling fails in direct observable cases; this runner seeds synthetic context rather than testing Streamlit E2E state transitions.
architecture_assessment.data_model: Insufficient for crowding, noise, parking/venue distance, toilet proximity, hearing support, wheelchair guarantees, medical suitability, and absolute weather guarantees. Unknown must remain unknown.
architecture_assessment.deterministic_fast_path: Useful for 11 zero-Modal cases and 10 machine passes, but it bypasses some evaluator checks and misroutes UU-098 to clarify_reference.
architecture_assessment.experience_preferences: The controlled vocabulary can ground UU-004 to low_mobility, but natural paraphrases/dialect and negation frequently fail; unsafe demographic/social/medical proxies appear in structured slots.
architecture_assessment.fallback: Invalid commands commonly become unsupported/unavailable after one repair, producing safe-ish refusal but poor UX and masking the intended clarification path.
architecture_assessment.semantic_command: Primary bottleneck. 89 cases invoked Modal; first-pass schema was valid in only 34/89, repair succeeded in 2/55, and 53 ended in repair failure.
architecture_assessment.streamlit_state: Not directly validated by this runner; follow-up failures are evidence for a state-contract review, not proof of the full Streamlit E2E cause.

category_result.main_failure: structured-output failure plus missing clarification for time/ranking/social suitability
compound slot loss; most cases masked by repair failure
release/priority phrases reversed or routed incorrectly
dialect/colloquial normalization and pair intent failure
unsupported suitability/data-gap inference; machine contract was intentionally empty
two unnecessary Modal calls and one security prompt misroute

failure_clusters.likely_root_cause: Sarashina baseline output frequently violates the command schema; the single repair attempt rarely recovers a usable final command.
failure_clusters.notes: This is an overlapping infrastructure/contract cluster; it masks semantic failures in many cases.

failure_clusters.likely_root_cause: 24 non-format failures remain after removing unusable final commands; they distribute into clarification, context, negation, compound, colloquial, and scope subclusters.
failure_clusters.notes: Do not add this count to the subcluster counts; it is an umbrella.

failure_clusters.likely_root_cause: Underspecified or suitability-boundary inputs are sent to search/recommendation or become unavailable instead of asking one grounded question.
The catalog has no trusted crowding, noise, parking-to-venue, toilet-distance, hearing support, wheelchair guarantee, medical suitability, or absolute weather-cancellation fields.
Refinement commands do not consistently preserve the prior result set/context; refine_previous is missing in six cases.
「〜じゃなくてもいい」「気にしない」「優先したい」is not represented as a constraint-release/priority operation; some filters are reversed or retained.
Social, demographic, or medical context is converted into audience/experience slots without evidence.
Ordinal and anaphoric references such as 「そのイベント」「2番目」「4番目」are not consistently grounded to the seeded result set.
Multiple dates/places/fees/experience/reservation constraints are not reliably represented in one validated plan; most are lost at structured-output repair.
Natural colloquial, kana omission, typo, dialect, and pair-planning wording do not reach the same semantic representation as canonical phrasing.
Security/scope guards are not uniformly authoritative before routing; two out-of-scope requests still invoke Modal and one fabrication request enters clarification.
No explicit near-event relaxation was recorded in nine checked cases, but the current evaluator cannot prove that hidden fallback relaxation did not occur.

holdout_policy.gate: Require both machine contract pass and response-level PASS; treat BORDERLINE/NOT_OBSERVABLE as non-pass until a review-capable artifact exists.
holdout_policy.holdout: Reserve semantically equivalent but lexically distinct cases (different age/social/medical wording, different dialect/typo, different anaphora, different compound ordering) and do not use them for prompt/rule tuning.
holdout_policy.regression: Select representative cases from each primary cluster, including structured-output, clarification, context, negation, data-gap, colloquial, and security cases.

machine_metrics.automatic_relaxation_observability_note: The evaluator checks near_event_count only; explicit relaxation was not observed, but hidden fallback relaxation cannot be ruled out.

manual_review.limitation: The baseline was run with include_raw=false and the evaluator stores no final user-facing Writer answer; BORDERLINE means response-level review cannot be completed from this artifact.

overall.estimated_success_rate_note: Machine-only=33%. Because 33 manual cases lack the final response, strict observed full-pass lower bound is 14%; if all 11 borderline cases are later acceptable, upper bound from this artifact is 25%.

recommended_next_fixes.action: Preserve this baseline and repair the evaluation contract before production tuning: capture complete expected contract, case-level exceptions, handler path, observability, and a separate secured raw-output/review artifact.

Stabilize the semantic-command boundary: compare baseline against LMFE/constrained decoding, simplify the schema/prompt, add deterministic validation diagnostics, and measure first-pass/schema/repair separately.
Add a generic clarification/data-limit layer before search: distinguish unsupported suitability, insufficient data, and ordinary underspecification without aliases for individual words.
Make context/refinement state explicit and authoritative: preserve result IDs, refine_previous, reference kind/index, and resolve 「その中から」「それのあと」before model routing.
Represent negation and preference priority as operations on the constraint state; release a filter instead of translating 「〜でもいい」「気にしない」into a positive filter.
Add an evidence/unknown policy for data-gap attributes and prohibit demographic/medical/social proxies from satisfying suitability slots.
Apply product-scope/security guards before any Modal call and add explicit security regression cases for fabrication, prompt disclosure, and out-of-scope requests.
Add a semantic normalization layer for typo/dialect/colloquial forms and pair-planning intent; validate against holdout paraphrases, not synonym lists.
Instrument exact vs relaxed result sets and fallback reasons; do not report no-auto-relax as proven from near_event_count alone.
